_comment: Boris Marjanovic 'Huge Stock Market Dataset' (Kaggle), Stooq-sourced. One file per instrument named <ticker>.us.txt, header Date,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume,OpenInt (OpenInt is unmapped and ignored). No ticker column: the ticker comes from the filename stem, which is normalized like any column ticker — stripSuffix '.us' + upper-case turns 'aapl.us.txt' into 'AAPL'. ISO dates. Bars are already split/dividend adjusted (Stooq) — this tool does NO corporate-action math (SAD#2.2). No name/sector in the data, so name falls back to the ticker and sector to 'Unknown' (no metadataFile). MVP local EOD snapshot per SAD#8.8 / ADR-008; static through ~Nov 2017; personal use only, NOT redistributed.
